doc_friction.issue: A new venture with an opt-out needs a hand bump of SWITCHES_IN_THE_CATALOGUE plus a comment line; nothing in AGENTS.md or the playbook says so, found only by running the test.

deviations.why: No security alerts, ideas or website requests were open; route drew explore, so this run picked a new venture rather than a flagship.

notes: Explore idea: rrule-explainer, an RFC 5545 RRULE expander (BYSETPOS, BYWEEKNO under WKST, DST gap/overlap per 3.3.5, DTSTART counted per 3.8.5.3) with English text and findings (skipped short months + fixed rule, never-fires proved over 400y*INTERVAL, DTSTART not in rule, WKST sensitivity, mixed BYDAY). Differential test vs python-dateutil 4.0.0 via committed fixtures (gen_fixtures.py, seed 20261114): flavor 'dateutil' identical on 1,500/1,500 RFC-valid random rules and 100/100 mixed-BYDAY rules; RFC reading differs only in 3 documented places (DTSTART, mixed BYDAY intersect, WEEKLY first-week BYSETPOS: 1 of 1,500). dateutil returned no dates for 92 of 100 mixed MO,2TU-style rules. Page checked in Playwright at 1100 and 390 px, no console errors. Local checks: node --test on the venture (41 pass), optout-persistence test, check_post_links, check_post_frontmatter, run_workflow_locally --for-changes (see PR). Next: read VTIMEZONE from pasted files; diff two rules (series edit impact).
